question: National Commission for Scheduled Tribes came into existence as a separate commission in which of the following year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2004.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The 89th Amendment of the Constitution came into force on 19 February 2004, and the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes has been set up under Article 338A.**
 
• National Commission for Scheduled
